title: Fusarium fungal wilt disease in cotton - Tanzania

Header: Fusarium fungal wilt disease in cotton - Tanzania
Fusarium oxysporum f.sp. vasinfectum Fusaria Mnyauko wa Pamba in Kiswahili language

Prevention: Use clean and certified seed or planting material.
Use variety resistant to the disease e.g.
Preventively treat seeds with a biopesticide preparation of
Trichoderma (ask certified seed treatment service provider or buy treated seeds).
Preventively use seeds treated with synthetic fungicides.
To slow down the disease, keep the soil
Bury deeply or burn residues after harvesting to avoid build-up of disease for the next cropping season.
However, if no major insect pests or diseases are in your crop, then leave the residues as they improve the soil, and reduce water evaporation.
Monitoring: This fungus lives in the soil and it works its way up through the plant.
First symptoms are normally seen in the field 1 and 2 months after planting.
Inspect the field once every week for diseased plants.
In seedling stage, symptoms begin as vein darkening, followed by the yellowing and shredding of leaves.
In older plants, symptoms are first seen on the lower leaves.
When you break a mature infected stem, streaks of brown tissue are seen inside the stem.
When 1-5 plants per plot are affected early, green direct action must be taken this season, and seed treatment be considered the following season.
Leaf chlorosis (yellow mottling) begins at the margin and spreads between the main veins, and goes upwards in the plants.
If all the leaves are affected, chlorosis turns to necrosis and finally the plant dies from moisture stress.
Direct Control: Prevention is the most powerful measure since control is difficult and often too late.
Uproot and burn the affected plants.
Restrictions: Chemical sprays have little to no effect because the disease moves inside the plant.

When using a pesticide or botanical, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage, timing of application, pre-harvest interval, max number of sprays, restricted re-entry interval.
Do not empty into drains and water sources.
